newsitem.title: JAPAN: Mitsui Petchem ask-only, Toatsu bid-only at open.
newsitem.headline: Mitsui Petchem ask-only, Toatsu bid-only at open.

text.p: Mitsui Petrochemical Industries Ltd shares were ask-only and Mitsui Toatsu Chemicals Inc bid-only in early Tuesday morning trade, brokers said, after the two firms said on Monday they were considering a merger.
The Tokyo Stock Exchange suspended trade in the shares of the two firms on Monday due to uncertainty over their merger plans.
At 0047 GMT Mitsui Petrochemical was ask-only at 575 yen, compared to Friday close of 767 yen. Mitsui Toatsu was bid-only at 401 yen after ending at 393 on Friday.
Company officials said details of the merger have not been decided.
But newspaper reports said on Monday that Mitsui Toatsu would be dissolved. It said 0.5 to 0.6 Mitsui Petrochemical shares would be exchanged for one Toatsu share.
